entry.summary: Josiah Tualamali’i has a background in authentic youth participation and assisting Pacific and other communities to share their voices in many different spaces. With Benji Timu, Josiah led the letter campaign and petition supporting the Polynesian Panthers' call for an apology for the ‘Dawn Raids’. An activist for improving youth health and wellbeing, in 2018 he served as the youth voice on the Government Inquiry into Mental Health and Addiction. Alongside the Rata Foundation, he is co-Chair of Pacific Wellbeing lead Le Va, and on the board of Te Pou.
